# Vfs Runtime Knobs

<!-- Generated by `cargo +nightly test -p vfs-cli --lib knobs::tests::generated_knobs_doc_matches_declarations -- --exact`. To regenerate: `VFS_UPDATE_KNOBS=1 cargo +nightly test -p vfs-cli --lib knobs::tests::generated_knobs_doc_matches_declarations -- --exact`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every active runtime knob is declared here with an architecture class. Defaults are rendered from the typed config declarations used by the SDK/core and FUSE adapter config modules.

| `VFS_CIPHER` | env or --cipher | product-config | `unset` | vfs CLI edge | Encryption cipher paired with VFS_KEY or --key. | n/a | opts clap env binding |
